data.name: ElevatedDescription
data.value: FocusGuard must run as your signed-in user. Close this window and start it without administrator elevation.

data.name: RuntimeMissingDescription
data.value: FocusGuard could not find the Microsoft Edge WebView2 Runtime. Install or repair the runtime, then retry. No session was started or changed.

data.name: HostFailureTitle
data.value: FocusGuard could not open its local interface

data.name: HostFailureDescription
data.value: The local interface could not be started. Your focus session was not changed. Retry to try again.

data.name: RendererFailureDescription
data.value: FocusGuard will retry the local interface. Any running focus session remains owned by the service.

data.name: ShellDescription
data.value: This local shell is ready for the React interface. It does not start or stop focus sessions.

data.name: BridgeUnavailable
data.value: Service access is disabled until Phase 4 authorization is integrated.

data.name: DeviceRecoveryDetail
data.value: This is the recovery path if you lose every linked device. Save it outside this PC, such as on paper or in a password manager. FocusGuard sends only the public recovery key to the cloud. Do not share this kit.

data.name: DeviceRecoverySaved
data.value: I saved this kit somewhere safe

data.name: DevicePairApprovalDetail
data.value: Only approve if you can compare this fingerprint with the one shown on the new device in person.

data.name: DevicePairCompared
data.value: I compared every character and the fingerprints match.

data.name: SettingsTransferShareDetail
data.value: Only the checked theme, language, and default timer duration will be added to an encrypted account document. App/site rules, profiles, permissions, schedules, and history are never included.

data.name: SettingsTransferImportDetail
data.value: Choose which shared values to apply here. Every unchecked setting and all local app/site rules remain unchanged.

data.name: PortableSettingsExportDetail
data.value: This creates a readable JSON file containing only theme, interface language, and default timer duration. Keep the file private. It contains no account identity, keys, paths, rules, permissions, or policies.

data.name: PortableSettingsImportDetail
data.value: Choose which values to apply to this PC. Unchecked values and other local preferences stay unchanged. The selected values will be saved here and, when settings sync is active, sent through its normal edit path.

data.name: PortableSettingsInvalid
data.value: The selected file is invalid or exceeds the 8 KiB limit.

data.name: SettingsSyncConsentDetail
data.value: FocusGuard will keep theme, interface language, and default timer duration in sync across devices linked to this account. Values are end-to-end encrypted. App/site rules, profiles, permissions, schedules, history, and active sessions stay local. You can turn sync off here at any time.

data.name: SettingsSyncResetTitle
data.value: Reset shared settings on linked devices?

data.name: SettingsSyncResetDetail
data.value: Current values — theme: {0}, interface language: {1}, default duration: {2} minutes. After reset — theme: {3}, interface language: {4}, default duration: {5} minutes. The encrypted reset applies when each linked device next syncs. Active focus sessions are not changed. App/site rules, profiles, permissions, schedules, and history remain local and unchanged. Continue?

data.name: SettingsSyncRecoveryDetail
data.value: This removes only the damaged local retry-delay file and recognized temporary files for this device and account. It does not change the encrypted outbox, local settings, or consent. FocusGuard will retry using the existing consent. Continue?

data.name: SettingsLocalOverridesTitle
data.value: Keep selected settings on this PC?

data.name: SettingsLocalOverridesDetail
data.value: Checked settings keep the values shown for this PC. Unchecked settings follow the latest verified shared or draft value. This choice stays local and does not change the account document.

data.name: SettingsLocalOverridesKeepLanguage
data.value: Keep interface language on this PC

data.name: SettingsLocalOverridesKeepDuration
data.value: Keep default duration on this PC
